description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Caitlyn''' fires a net in the target direction and [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|recoils]] 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them by 50% for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Caitlyn fires a net in the target direction and recoils 390 units in the opposite direction. The net deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 50% for 1 second.

description2.raw: '''''Caitlyn''' will not recoil after the cast time if she was [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilized]] or [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] during it. She can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the recoil dash.''
description2.text: Caitlyn will not recoil after the cast time if she was immobilized or grounded during it. She can cast any of her abilities during the recoil dash.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 (+ 80% AP)

notes.raw: * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * The recoil can be used to pass through terrain. * If '''Caitlyn''' buffers [[File:Caitlyn Piltover Peacemaker.png|20xpx|border|link=Caitlyn#Piltover Peacemaker|An icon for Caitlyn's ability Piltover Peacemaker]] [[Caitlyn#Piltover Peacemaker|Piltover Peacemaker]] during ''90 Caliber Net's'' cast time, [[File:Caitlyn Piltover Peacemaker.png|20xpx|border|link=Caitlyn#Piltover Peacemaker|An icon for Caitlyn's ability Piltover Peacemaker]] [[Caitlyn#Piltover Peacemaker|Piltover Peacemaker]] will start after the cast time. ** If '''Caitlyn''' buffers an ability or [[basic attack]] during this ability's cast time, the buffered ability or basic attack will instead start after the dash ends. ** Other abilities can be cast while [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashing]] if they are input after the cast time. * ''90 Caliber Net's'' missile will fail to fire if '''Caitlyn''' is [[File:Suppression icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|An icon representing the keyword Suppression]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|suppressed]] during the cast time.(unexpected)
notes.text:
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
The recoil can be used to pass through terrain.
If Caitlyn buffers Piltover Peacemaker during 90 Caliber Net's cast time, Piltover Peacemaker will start after the cast time.
* If Caitlyn buffers an ability or basic attack during this ability's cast time, the buffered ability or basic attack will instead start after the dash ends.
* Other abilities can be cast while dashing if they are input after the cast time.
90 Caliber Net's missile will fail to fire if Caitlyn is suppressed during the cast time.(unexpected)
